exact: The most frequent author keywords in this cluster are Amazon, cytotoxicity, antimalarial, antileishmanial and antiplasmodial activities, and studies with flavonoid and triterpene compounds and antioxidant, anti-tumor and anti-inflammatory activities.

Moreover, it can be found tests of cytotoxicity, anti-inflammatory, analgesic and anti-gastric ulcer activities, and studies with phenolic compounds, flavonoids, tannins, terpenes, volatile compounds (essential oils and aromas), and fatty compounds and dyes.
